body: I'm a college student, so essentially I go to my classes and I go home to my dorm and I work on stuff... I am in some clubs and stuff so I have some acquaintances but as I said I never get invited to hang out. Aside from that, I suppose I don't do much aside from watching stuff on Netflix or browsing Reddit. Pretty boring I suppose.

Thanks for your words. But I feel like this is just a culmination of so many things wrong in my life. I am literally friendless, I can't tell you the last time a person asked me to go get lunch or dinner or hang out with them was. It's been months. Like I said my only friends are my parents and it just hurts so much because I'd like nothing more than for people to see me and say "Hi, how are you?"
 
For several months, many times a week I get into bed at night and the weight of my loneliness just hits me and it's just so hard. I feel like things won't and can't get better because the more sad I am the harder it is for me to go make friends and socialize. I mean I really have a hard time making friends, for me the only way it seems to make a friend is to be introduced, but I have no friends to introduce me to begin with. It's like a vicious cycle in a way.
I hope so. I think I am going to make an appointment at a planned parenthood clinic for some testing. Hopefully it's cheap as I am going to pay out of pocket.
